description.value: Shearwater Resort & Marina is a Heiltsuk Nation-owned wilderness resort and fishing lodge on Denny Island, a short water taxi from Bella Bella on BC's Central Coast. The resort offers rooms, a marina, and a restaurant, and serves as the main service hub for visitors exploring the Great Bear Rainforest.
